assessment: This paper is of interest to a broad audience of cell biologists, pharmacologists and researchers who work in metabolic diseases. The work provides substantial new insights into the mechanism of action for a plant derived pentacyclic triterpene called celastrol elastrol, in effectively reducing the high fat diet induced tissue hypertrophy in mouse liver and adipose. A series of compelling experiments depict the site of covalent inhibition of the ER stress sensor GRP78 as essential for the beneficial effects in-vivo, supporting the main conclusions.
